The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Asteria]] operated from a fortified '''townhouse'''. The criminal conducted meetings at the townhouse. After one such meeting, with Asteria's associate [[Snoova]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], the Wookiee was jumped by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] thugs and imprisoned at the behest of the [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Lonay]].
